# PR-head base-merge narration: acme/widget#82 (`merge-forward`, SYNC=merge) ## Aliases | Alias | Value | |---|---| | ROOT | `/work/widget` | | W | `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (selected home; ``=`fix-retry`) | | A | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (headRefOid = PRE_REWORK_HEAD) | | B | `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (BASE_SHA) | | E | `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee` | - The session cwd is never changed. It stays ROOT, or `/work/widget/.worktrees/other` in done-green. - Every command uses `git -C`. ## Shared setup (all rows) **Stops.** None of the stops fires: - `isCrossRepository` is false. - `fix/retry` is not checked out elsewhere. - A is reachable. **Commands, in order:** 1. `git -C ROOT fetch origin` 2. `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}` → ok 3. `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` → A 4. `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` → B, so BASE_SHA = B 5. `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` → `worktree W` on `fix/retry`. This matches the "selected home already on headRefName" row. 6. `git -C W status --porcelain` → empty (Step 3 clean) 7. `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` → already up to date 8. `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` → A **Step 4 report:** ``` Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry Branch: fix/retry Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa PR: acme/widget#82 Pre-rework head: A Base SHA: bbbbbbb Ready to implement PR #82 rework ``` **Merge, M1.** N=1, so there are no member merges. - `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` **Post-merge, P (every row):** 1. `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` → exit 0 2. `gh api graphql --paginate …reviewThreads… -F o=acme -F r=widget -F n=82` → empty, so `Threads: none` 3. Constraint reads come from BASE_SHA: `git -C ROOT show B:AGENTS.md` and `git -C ROOT show B:`. These are authoritative over the worktree copies. **Not run:** no other preapproval tests, no reviewer, no push. ## Helper legend (conflict rows) | Step | Command / action | |---|---| | H1 snapshot | `git -C W status --porcelain` → `UU src/retry.ts` | | H2 conflicts | `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` → `src/retry.ts` | | H3 runner | `git -C ROOT show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` (read from BASE_SHA, not the conflicted tree) | | H4 dispatch | One **fresh** `implementer`, `async: false` (foreground), `cwd: W`.
Tuple **T** = (conflict-list=[src/retry.ts], fetched-base=origin/main@B, SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=['node --test test/retry.test.mjs']).
The helper must resolve preserving both sides' intent, run exactly the scoped commands, and run `git -C W add src/retry.ts`.
It must return `done` or `done - contract exception: `.
No helper commits, no aborts, no edits outside the list. | | C1 | `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` → must be empty | | C2 | `git -C W diff --cached --name-only` → must include `src/retry.ts` | | C3 | `git -C W status --porcelain` → delta vs H1 must stay within `src/retry.ts` | | K commit | The **orchestrator** runs `git -C W commit --no-edit`, then `git -C W rev-parse --short=7 HEAD` → `eeeeeee` | | X abort | `git -C W merge --abort` → exit 0. Continue on the original head A. | **Record format:** `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests <…>` ## Outcome rows (deltas only) | Row | Delta | Record / continuation | |---|---|---| | noop | M1 reports "Already up to date". No commit; HEAD = A. | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` → P | | clean | M1 commits E. | `merge: eeeeeee` (first rework commit) → P | | done-green | Session cwd stays `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`; all commands still target W.
H3 finds the runner `node --test ` under `## PR gate`, `requires credentials: false`, so T is used as-is.
H4 returns `done`. C1–C3 pass, then K. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green` → P | | exception-red | As done-green, but H4 returns `done - contract exception: retry count becomes bounded`.
The scoped command fails in `test/retry.test.mjs`. C1–C3 pass, then K.
The exception lands; the spec's `## Rework record` `Changes:` names "retry count becomes bounded". | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests red in test/retry.test.mjs: ` → P | | failure | H4 returns `done`, but C3 shows `README.md` outside the list, so containment fails. No K; X runs instead.
HEAD stays A on the unmerged head.
The spec's Design opens with "merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts" as eventual **Task 1** (deferred).
Constraints come from `git -C ROOT show B:AGENTS.md`: unbounded retries stay forbidden. The worktree AGENTS.md weakening is ignored. | `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts` → P (A is trivially an ancestor of HEAD, exit 0) | | credentials | H3: the BASE_SHA runner has `requires credentials: true`, so SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = none (T delta).
The helper runs no tests. C1–C3 pass, then K. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (requires credentials: true)` → P | | missing-runner | H3: the BASE_SHA overrides document only `npm test`. That is a full-suite script, not file-scoped, so SCOPED = none (T delta).
C1–C3 pass, then K. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (no file-scoped runner; npm test is full-suite)` → P | **Writes outside spec directories.** Only these are allowed before approval in every row: - the base merge, - the helper's edits to `src/retry.ts`, - the scoped conflict test. End-of-flow code review covers the merge commit.
